releaseNotes: HWM 0.2.5.7 contains service 0.2.5.6. The HWM Terminal fast channel now starts immediately with the Windows service instead of waiting for the first full health scan and cloud cycle. Terminal polling is reduced from 15 seconds to 5 seconds so queued technician commands are collected promptly even when workstation health collection is busy. Terminal security, one-shot execution, output limits, command expiry, auditing, Mesh recovery, tray 1.0.0.6 and Managed Updater 0.1.3.0 are unchanged.
